summary: Arbe Robotics Ltd. filed a foreign private issuer report (Form 6-K) furnishing a notice of its 2026 annual general meeting of shareholders. The meeting will be held virtually on September 2, 2026, with proposals including election of Class II directors, approval of CEO and executive compensation terms, non-executive director equity awards, an amended compensation policy, re-appointment of KPMG as auditor, and authorization of a reverse share split if needed to meet Nasdaq listing requirements. This is a routine shareholder meeting notice with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign. The filing serves as a proxy solicitation and governance update, not a transaction announcement.
